schema.name: Perimeter81ActivityLogsV2_CL
schema.description: Perimeter 81 (Check Point SASE) activity log events. Contains user login attempts, VPN connections, application access sessions, and administrative actions with source IP, actor, device, and network context.

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Required source timestamp supplied by Check Point Event Forwarding

columns.name: RawData
columns.description: Original Check Point payload, preserved unchanged including Syslog framing and batched events.

columns.name: ParseStatus
columns.description: Parsed, Batched, NonCef, or MalformedCef. Batched and unparsed payloads remain in RawData.

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: Event identifier from the CEF id extension.

columns.name: EventTime
columns.description: Event timestamp from createdAt, falling back to time for SASE events.

columns.name: EventName
columns.description: Activity name from event, falling back to product for SASE events.

columns.name: EventCategory
columns.description: Activity category from category, falling back to product_family for SASE events.

columns.name: Severity
columns.description: Severity from the CEF severity extension.

columns.name: ActorEmail
columns.description: Actor from the CEF createdBy extension; may be an email address or a system identity.

columns.name: Module
columns.description: Originating module, such as HarmonySASE or CLOUDINFRA.

columns.name: Message
columns.description: Activity details from eventData, falling back to the message in the SASE data JSON extension.

columns.name: CefExtensions
columns.description: Parsed CEF extensions. Semicolons are replaced with spaces for CEF parsing; RawData is unchanged.
